technologies: Business intelligence and data analysis software

steps.title: Open the supplier purchase invoice and check the pre-filled expense account
Reclassify equipment purchases from small tools to capital equipment accounts

decision.description: Equipment costing over {threshold} is capex: move {line.expense_account} from small tools to Plants and Machineries and the cost center to Production, instead of leaving the default small-tools booking.
decision.from_value: small tools account with default cost center
decision.to_value: Plants and Machineries account with Production cost center
decision.counterfactual: If the item cost were below 5,000, it would stay in small tools with the default cost center.

steps.title: Screen the invoice list for the next supplier and recognize a repeat amount

decision.description: The supplier's amount matches an already-paid December invoice, so treat it as a suspected duplicate rather than a normal booking.
decision.counterfactual: If the amount had not matched a paid invoice, the invoice would have been reviewed and booked normally.

steps.title: Hold the suspected duplicate invoice until supplier confirmation
Open the next invoice and identify that it belongs to the UK subsidiary
Escalate UK-subsidiary invoices for second approval before booking

guardrails.text: Any purchase invoice line over 5,000 booked to small tools is a capex mistake: it must go to Plants and Machineries with the Production cost center.
When this supplier sends a December invoice with the same amount as one already paid (old invoice number plus a suffix), put it On Hold until the supplier confirms — do not book it.
guardrails.owner: Accounts Payable lead — confirm duplicate with the supplier

guardrails.text: Anything from the UK subsidiary needs a second approval from the controller before it is booked.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Equipment over 5,000 is always capex here, so it goes to Plants and Machineries and the Production cost center, never to small tools.

translations.de: Anlagen über 5.000 sind hier immer capex, sie gehen also auf Anlagen und Maschinen und die Kostenstelle Produktion, niemals auf Kleinwerkzeuge.
translations.fr: Les équipements de plus de 5 000 sont toujours de l'immobilisation ici, donc ils vont aux Installations et Machines et au centre de coûts Production, jamais aux petits outillages.
translations.es: Los equipos de más de 5.000 son siempre capex aquí, así que van a Plantas y Maquinaria y al centro de costes de Producción, nunca a herramientas pequeñas.
translations.ru: Оборудование дороже 5 000 у нас всегда относится к капвложениям, значит оно идёт на «Здания и оборудование» и в центр затрат «Производство», но никак не в мелкий инструмент.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Booked to small tools, that's wrong for a compressor.

translations.de: Auf Kleinwerkzeuge gebucht, das ist falsch für einen Kompressor.
translations.fr: Comptabilisé en petit outillage, c'est faux pour un compresseur.
translations.es: Contabilizado en herramientas pequeñas, eso está mal para un compresor.
translations.ru: Проведено по мелкому инструменту, для компрессора это неверно.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Same amount as the December invoice that we already paid.

translations.de: Gleicher Betrag wie die Dezemberrechnung, die wir bereits bezahlt haben.
translations.fr: Même montant que la facture de décembre que nous avons déjà payée.
translations.es: El mismo importe que la factura de diciembre que ya pagamos.
translations.ru: Та же сумма, что и у декабрьского счёта, который мы уже оплатили.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Velt again. Two eight fifty, that number looks familiar from December.

translations.de: Velt wieder. 2.850, diese Zahl kommt mir aus dem Dezember bekannt vor.
translations.fr: Encore Velt. Deux mille huit cent cinquante, ce chiffre me rappelle décembre.
translations.es: Velt otra vez. Dos mil ochocientos cincuenta, ese número me suena de diciembre.
translations.ru: Опять Velt. Две тысячи восемьсот пятьдесят, эта сумма кажется знакомой с декабря.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: This supplier double-bills every December; hold it until they confirm. Same amount, just a suffix on the old invoice number.

translations.de: Dieser Lieferant stellt jeden Dezember doppelt in Rechnung; zurückhalten, bis sie bestätigen. Gleicher Betrag, nur ein Suffix an der alten Rechnungsnummer.
translations.fr: Ce fournisseur facture en double chaque décembre ; bloquez-la jusqu'à leur confirmation. Même montant, juste un suffixe sur l'ancien numéro de facture.
translations.es: Este proveedor factura por duplicado cada diciembre; reténgalo hasta que lo confirmen. Mismo importe, solo un sufijo en el número de factura antiguo.
translations.ru: Этот поставщик каждый декабрь выставляет счёт дважды; придержите его, пока не подтвердят. Та же сумма, просто суффикс к старому номеру счёта.

quotes.speaker: Erika Expert
quotes.text: Anything from the UK subsidiary needs a second approval from the controller before it is booked.

translations.de: Alles von der britischen Tochtergesellschaft benötigt eine zweite Freigabe durch den Controller, bevor es gebucht wird.
translations.fr: Tout ce qui vient de la filiale britannique nécessite une seconde approbation du contrôleur avant d'être comptabilisé.
translations.es: Todo lo de la filial británica necesita una segunda aprobación del controller antes de contabilizarse.
translations.ru: Всё от британской дочерней компании требует повторного согласования финансовым контролёром до проведения в учёте.

open_unknowns.hypothesis: The 5,000 capex threshold may be tied to a depreciation or tax policy rather than pure internal convention.
open_unknowns.spoken_question: Is the 5,000 capex cutoff from tax rules or internal policy?
open_unknowns.resolution: Equipment over 5,000 net is capex: Plants and Machineries and the Production cost center.

extracted_rule.condition: The 5,000 capex cutoff is an internal accounting policy (not a statutory tax rule): equipment purchases with a net value over 5,000, booked to the Plants and Machineries account in the Production cost center, must be capitalized as fixed assets rather than expensed.
extracted_rule.action: Capitalize as capex (record as fixed asset in Plants and Machineries) instead of expensing

open_unknowns.hypothesis: The expert spotted the duplicate because of the supplier's known December pattern plus a suffix on the paid invoice number.
open_unknowns.spoken_question: Does the December duplicate check apply to all suppliers or just this one?
open_unknowns.resolution: If the amount matches an invoice we already paid, put it on hold and ask the supplier before anything else.

extracted_rule.condition: an invoice amount matches an invoice that has already been paid
extracted_rule.threshold: exact amount match to an already-paid invoice
extracted_rule.action: place the invoice on hold and ask the supplier

open_unknowns.hypothesis: Duplicate detection relied on recognizing the amount from memory; no systematic duplicate search was shown.
open_unknowns.spoken_question: How do you find duplicates if you don't remember the amount?

extracted_rule.condition: supplier and supplier_invoice_no match an already-posted invoice (used when amount is not remembered)
extracted_rule.action: flag as potential duplicate and hold for review
